{
 "study": "A randomized clinical trial of a low-carbohydrate diet compared with usual diet on 6-month change in hemoglobin A 1c among adults with untreated hemoglobin A 1c of 6.0% to 6.9%",
 "design": "parallel 2-arm",
 "country": "",
 "duration": "6 months",
 "n_randomized_total": "141",
 "experimental_arm": {
  "label": "low-carbohydrate diet",
  "intervention_description": "behavioral counseling and key supplemental food; target <40 g net carbohydrates per day for first 3 months; then, <60 g",
  "n_randomized": "75",
  "n_analyzed": "73",
  "hba1c_change_mean": "-0.24",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion": "0.33 to -0.19",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion_type": "95% CI",
  "hba1c_baseline_mean": "6.17",
  "hba1c_baseline_sd": "0.31",
  "hba1c_final_mean": "6.14",
  "hba1c_final_sd": "0.30"
 },
 "control_arm": {
  "label": "usual diet",
  "intervention_description": "written information with standard dietary advice",
  "n_randomized": "75",
  "n_analyzed": "75",
  "hba1c_change_mean": "-0.04",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion": "0.10 to -0.02",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion_type": "95% CI",
  "hba1c_baseline_mean": "6.16",
  "hba1c_baseline_sd": "0.30",
  "hba1c_final_mean": "6.12",
  "hba1c_final_sd": "0.29"
 }
}
